about.title: About UBOSS
about.subtitle: Making AI accessible to the businesses that power our communities.
about.founderStory: UBOSS was founded by Robert, a first-generation Salvadoran-American software engineer raised in Greater Boston. Growing up watching his father work long hours as a mason in the local trades, he developed a deep appreciation for small businesses run by hardworking immigrants and families. As a bilingual senior engineer and father himself, he saw firsthand how these operations were often left behind by big tech—lacking the tools for real insight and growth.
about.vision: We envision a community where local small and medium businesses are truly supported. Where passionate owners can run their companies with clarity, total confidence in every decision, and the freedom to focus on what they do best.
about.vision2: UBOSS exists to build the systems that enhance performance, reduce overwhelm, and turn daily operations from a source of stress into one of pride and strength.
about.pegasusStory: Our brand is named after Pegasus — the mythological winged horse. Like Pegasus, we believe in the power of combining raw strength with the ability to soar. Our infrastructure runs on a server we affectionately call Pegasus, the workhorse that powers everything we build for our clients.
about.founderSiteText: Learn more about Robert at Robg.dev
about.imageAlt: Robert Gutierrez, Founder of UBOSS LLC
about.founderStory2: That's why UBOSS bridges the gap with practical, accessible technology. Just as a skilled tradesperson delivers a custom fit for every job, we develop automation for businesses in various ways and provide in-house solutions that make the most sense for each company at the present moment. With tailored developer tools and custom dashboards, we deliver clear insights into day-to-day operations—helping trades businesses grow, scale, and thrive regardless of language or technical background.

services.title: The Problems We Solve
services.subtitle: These are the problems that cost most owners time, sleep, and jobs. Here's what changes when we fix them.

automation.title: We Handle the Repetitive Work
automation.pain: Most owners let admin pile up until the end of the day or week, then burn an evening catching up.
automation.solution: We set up systems that handle the repetitive work in the background. Your only job is to check status and decide what happens next, instead of doing the work yourself.

assistants.title: We Strengthen Communication
assistants.pain: A job can be done well and still leave the customer frustrated if they never hear from you. The same gaps create confusion inside the team.
assistants.solution: We put simple systems in place so every client gets a fast, clear response and your team always knows the current status, without you having to chase anyone.

dashboards.title: We Show You How Your Business Is Really Doing
dashboards.pain: What keeps most owners up isn't the work itself — it's not knowing whether the business is actually healthy.
dashboards.solution: We pull the important numbers into one clear view so you can see what's making money, what's draining it, and where attention is needed. Red flags show up early instead of becoming surprises.

integrations.title: Your Tools Finally Talk to Each Other
integrations.pain: Most of the tools that were supposed to make life easier still demand your time — entering data, moving it between systems, double-checking numbers.
integrations.solution: We connect and automate those steps so the information is already where it needs to be. You stop transferring data and start using it.

digitization.title: We Digitize Your Paper Trail
digitization.pain: How many times have important details lived on a napkin or the back of your hand — one wash away from disappearing?
digitization.solution: We help put simple systems in place so the critical information actually gets captured, stored, and used instead of lost.

pricing.comparisonTitle: What are you really paying for?
pricing.comparisonBody1: Most growing businesses don't need just one person — they need someone to handle data, someone to answer calls, and someone to coordinate operations. That's three hires. Three salaries. Three sets of sick days, holidays, and human errors.
pricing.comparisonBody2: Each one of those employees would cost your business over $25,000 a year. UBoss bundles all three roles into one seamless system — and it never calls in sick.
pricing.comparisonBanner: UBoss works 24/7 — 365 days a year, including holidays. No sick days. No human error. Always on.
pricing.comparisonDisclaimer: † UBoss operates 24/7 including weekends and holidays. Scheduled maintenance windows may occur monthly — clients are notified in advance of any planned downtime. Hourly rate estimates based on Greater Boston market data. Figures shown represent conservative entry-level rates. Actual employer costs including payroll taxes, benefits, and workers’ compensation typically add 10–25% above base wages.
